<!--
请用中文或英文填写，二选一即可。
You may write in either Chinese or English.
-->

**你的功能建议与问题相关吗？ / Is your feature request related to a problem?**
清晰描述问题。A clear description of the problem. 例如：当……时，我总是感到困惑 / e.g. I'm always frustrated when...

**你期望的解决方案 / Describe the solution you'd like**
清晰描述你想要的方案。A clear description of what you want to happen.

**你考虑过的替代方案 / Describe alternatives you've considered**
可选。Any alternative solutions or features you've considered.

**其他 / Additional context**
可选。Add any other context or screenshots.
